6. The complete physical interface remains the decisive test
Local loss and dephasing survive the dark encoding

Equal canonical amplitude damping is invariant under passive mode rotations. Encoding in dark modes therefore does not eliminate independent photon loss.

Parity detection also has limits. Logical-rail parity misses auxiliary loss; total parity does not distinguish every even-jump history; local dephasing need not change photon parity at all.
